Icarus thought. I Here was his chance to be someone to be more than just a link in a chain stretching from an Earth he'd never walked to an alien planet he'd never see. No one in history had ever explored a black hole. No one had even gone near one. Icarus quickly turned the calculations he'd used to create his new engine over and over in his mind, checking and rechecking the figures, and he definitively concluded that his redesigned Runabout could triumph over the powerful pull of a black hole.
